explanation: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the RBI.
Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1), Additional Tier 1, and Retained Earnings form Tier 1 Capital. Subordinated debt is part of Tier 2 Capital.
Under current guidelines, the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) insures deposits up to a maximum of 5 Lakh INR per depositor per bank.
